# ego-lite

`server/ego-browser.ts`'s `EGO_BROWSER_SYSTEM_PROMPT` adapts the usage guidance
of the ego-browser skill in [citrolabs/ego-lite](https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite)
(MIT, see `LICENSE`), as of commit `bacaece43900e8ca68eea3b6f1663835ea38df9e`.
No file from that repository is included.

ego lite, the browser itself, is proprietary software of Citro Labs Pte.
Limited under its own terms (https://lite.ego.app/terms). It is not part of
this repository: each person installs it on their own computer.
